roadmap: 11 ③b inch display and dual dimensions (CG5 DR-7)
tier: full (drawing document fields + public API + printed numbers): three audit rounds with mutation and property probes, actual run
before: measured 2026-10-31: drawings printed mm only (UNITS cell hard-coded), dimension values rounded to 0.01 and tolerances too (±0.125 printed ±0.13, a widened zone)

change.fields: drawing.units 'mm' | 'inch' (display only, the model stays mm), drawing.dual (secondary unit in brackets after the primary), drawing.precision {mm, inch} (0–6 places); canonical order standard, units, dual, precision
change.numbers: formatLength: inch = mm / 25.4, no leading zero, zeros kept to the precision (default 3); a dimension with a tolerance prints its LIMITS inside the true zone — nominal rounded to nearest at p places, upper deviation floored and lower ceiled relative to it, p raised (inch ≤ 5, mm ≤ 4) until no nonzero deviation prints zero and the zone keeps ≥ 80 % of its width, else UNIT_PRECISION; nominal and deviations at the same places (Y14.5 §1.6.2); plain mm tolerances as entered (fixes the old 0.01 rounding); fits keep their designation with deviations by the same rule; GD&T frame widths round down, projected heights up, unequal amounts nearest within 5 %
change.coverage: linear/radial/diameter/PCD dimensions, tolerances, fits, hole callouts, bearing ring width, GD&T values, datum target sizes, weld symbol sizes and weld list cells (estimate mark kept), source-table mm columns, DXF text and 3D annotations (alt carries the other unit); thread designations, typed notes and element-table size sentences stay as written (labelled mm)
change.layout: a dual text wider than the space between the arrowheads is lifted clear of its line and arrowheads under every standard
change.studio: sheet settings: Drawing units (mm / inch), Dual units, Details → Decimals in mm / inch; each one undo step
change.chat: set_drawing accepts units, dual, precision with refusals; per-turn budget unchanged 24,997

audits.round1: CHANGES_REQUIRED: wrong numbers — tolerances, GD&T values and fit deviations printed as zero or widened (±0.005 mm → ±.000; ±0.05 at 1 mm place → ±0.1), weld list header/cells mismatch, weld sizes unconverted, plain-mm 0.01 rounding (pre-existing); root: dual text over its arrowhead. 13/13 mutants caught (none for the wrong numbers)
audits.round2: CHANGES_REQUIRED: printed limits still outside the true zone in 27–40 % of 20k random values (nominal rounded to nearest), fits' nominal at fewer places than its deviations; 23/26 mutants caught
audits.round3: targeted ACCEPT: 0 outside in the auditor's own 20k-case probes for every setting incl. dual secondaries and fits

checks.propertyTest: 120,000 cases in the suite, 0 printed limits outside the true zone

actualRun.run03: final source PASS on bracket.bcad: Drawing, Auto-dimension; Drawing units → inch (model nodes unchanged), Dual units, Undo/Redo, Details → Decimals in inch 2; Save + fresh Open equal; oracle by its own arithmetic: inch 1.181 / .472 / .236 with UNITS inch, dual 1.181 [30] / .472 [12] / .236 [6] with UNITS inch [mm], two places 1.18 [30] / .47 [12] / .24 [6], mm unchanged; 0 page/console errors; root reviewed zoomed renders (the short dual text lifted clear of its arrowheads)
earlierRuns: run01 PASS (dual text over its arrowhead, found by the root's image review)

followUps: a zero-width zone (upper = lower) is accepted and prints an inverted pair in inch (flagged by UNIT_PRECISION)
non-dual short dimensions can still touch their arrowheads (as at HEAD) — lifting them changes the kernel's DXF fixture (packages/barocss-cad, kernel lane)
chat drawing.set hint (groups.ts) does not list standard/units/dual/precision (per-turn budget full)
DXF DIMSTYLE header stays mm/3.5 (kernel lane, with D396)
